lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with regular vertical spacing between primary centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated intensity intersecting with the primary circular blobs to form a regular grid-like coordinate system along the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features across the upper flank exhibiting a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient, indicating structural ridges running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of smaller, lower-intensity spots relative to the larger primary lateral flank blobs.
